verdict.rationale: YubiKey is a hardware authentication device: a smartcard with FIDO2, PIV, OpenPGP and OTP applets, plus SDKs and a management CLI. Acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools is a capability of AI agents and assistants, so this axis does not apply. Nothing in the evidence shows YubiKey shipping any such client capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
